name: garbo
title: Garbo: The Spy Whose Agents Didn't Exist

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: Voice only, no music or sound effects. Read this at a brisk pace, about 170 words per minute, like a punchy, slightly witty YouTube Shorts history narrator. Confident and energetic, with only tiny pauses between sentences

scenes.say: In 1944, Hitler's top spy in Britain ran twenty-seven agents. Not one of them was real.
scenes.tts: In nineteen forty-four, Hitler's top spy in Britain ran twenty-seven agents. Not one of them was real.
scenes.direction: with a dramatic beat before 'Not one'

scenes.say: Juan Pujol, a Spanish chicken farmer, hated the Nazis. He offered to spy for Britain. They said no. So he came up with a better plan. Spy for Germany... and feed them lies.
scenes.tts: Juan Poo-HOLE, a Spanish chicken farmer, hated the Nazis. He offered to spy for Britain. They said no. So he came up with a better plan. Spy for Germany... and feed them lies.
scenes.direction: deadpan on 'They said no', sly at the end

scenes.say: He wasn't even in Britain. From Lisbon, he faked it all with a guidebook, train timetables and newsreels. His lies were so good, Germany's navy chased a convoy he'd made up. Suddenly, Britain wanted him after all.
MI5, Britain's spy-catchers, named him Garbo, the best actor in the world, and together they invented a whole spy network.
scenes.tts: M-I-5, Britain's spy-catchers, named him Garbo, the best actor in the world, and together they invented a whole spy network.

scenes.say: My man in Liverpool missed the whole fleet!

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Say it like a panicked Spanish spy in 1943, with a light Spanish accent, quick and comic

voice.name: Orus
voice.style: Say it like a calm, dry British intelligence officer in 1943

scenes.say: And died! Put it in the paper.

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Say it like a delighted Spanish spy in 1943, with a light Spanish accent, quick and comic

scenes.say: Germany paid all their salaries. Three days after D-Day, Garbo told Berlin: Normandy is a trick. The real invasion is coming at Calais.
For weeks, a German army sat at Calais, waiting for an invasion that never came. Hitler approved an Iron Cross for him. Britain gave him a medal too... for the same lies.
scenes.direction: deadpan beat before 'for the same lies'

scenes.say: After the war, he faked his own death, and vanished. Forty years later, a historian found him alive, in Venezuela. That June, he walked Normandy's beaches, as veterans lined up to thank him.
scenes.direction: quieter and warmer, slower at the very end
